name: Angel Beats! -1st beat-
source:
Angel Beats! is a collaboration project of Key, Dengeki G's, and Aniplex.

The story of the visual novel is to be based on the Angel Beats! anime series. The player takes on the role of Otonashi, a newcomer to the Afterlife who finds himself in the middle of a struggle between a group of students who call themselves the Shinda Sekai Sensen ("Afterlife Battlefront"), or SSS for short, and a mysterious girl who is known under the alias of Tenshi (Angel). The story will undergo changes from the original anime and will include story routes with each of the characters. It also stated that Otonashi will be very different than his original personality in the anime, and will change according to the choices made by the player.

[Edited from [url=http://angelbeats.wikia.com/wiki/Angel_Beats!_(visual_novel)]Angel Beats! wiki[/url]]

Rumors of a game release existed since 2010, but a formal game announcement was made in 2013. The first volume was released on June 26, 2015. Only the first volume had been released while the other five planned volumes have been abandoned with no announcement. The Angel Beats! collaborations in Key x Wright Flyer Studios gacha game [url=/v33924]HEAVEN BURNS RED[/url] contain content that would've been in 2nd beat and beyond.
translation:
《Angel Beats!》是Key、电击G's和Aniplex共同开展的企划。

这部视觉小说的故事改编自《Angel Beats!》动画。玩家将扮演初来死后世界的音无，置身于自称死后世界战线（“死后世界战线”，简称SSS）的学生团体，与一名以“天使”为别名的神秘少女之间的冲突中心。故事会在原动画基础上有所变化，并加入每名角色各自的路线。据称，音无的性格将与动画原作大不相同，并会根据玩家做出的选择而改变。

[改编自[url=http://angelbeats.wikia.com/wiki/Angel_Beats!_(visual_novel)]Angel Beats! Wiki[/url]]

自2010年起便有游戏即将发售的传闻，但直到2013年才正式公布。第一卷于2015年6月26日发售。原定的六卷中只有第一卷问世，其余五卷在没有任何说明的情况下被放弃。Key与Wright Flyer Studios合作推出的抽卡游戏[url=/v33924]《HEAVEN BURNS RED》[/url]中的《Angel Beats!》联动内容，包含了原本计划放入第二卷及后续作品的剧情。
